orrowen: Cadhan o hosen re yal cadhat lona
meanings: This we two lay as it was laid for us two: the hearth formula in the dual, for a leaf a bonded pair lays (Halyna's V.1)
derivation: a phrase: Cadhan lay-1DU (cadh + -An, broad: -an, orrowen_v2 §3.4) + o his/it(+S) + hosen as + re PST(+S) + yal S·be.PST + cadhat laid + lona at-1DU (lo + the 1DU ending, §3.6); the formula of O0238/O0234 with the dual, as §3.9 item 1 requires of Halyna ('where the Book gives Halyna a plural verb, the Orrowen original is dual'); unit S07 (V.1)
